Defaults: mains 1,225 lb per side (2,450 lb total), aux 79 USG per side (B200 figure). Check these against your aircraft's POH. A capacity entered in gallons or litres converts to lb at the current density; one entered in lb stays fixed.

Volume to weight (check the receipt)

CFS values are based on the maximum density limit for each product, so actual fuel is usually a bit lighter and the true weight per litre a bit lower. For exact numbers, enter the density from the dealer's certified batch analysis. Always confirm fuel quantity visually and against the gauges.
Traced from B200 AFM Section 5 charts (Dec 1994). Checked against each chart's own worked example: all within 2.5%. These are unfactored AFM distances. Use as a cross-check and study tool; dispatch numbers come from the AFM charts or your company-approved data.

Charts

Show the math
Ice vanes: the AFM takeoff distance charts say add 10°C to OAT; accelerate-stop is not affected. Colder than a chart's coldest line, the app uses that coldest line (conservative). CRFI: TC AIM AIR 1.6.7 Tables 1.3/1.4 (Oct 2024 edition). TC gives CRFI corrections for landing only, not takeoff. Not included yet: accelerate-go, climb-limited weights.
